svg.title: Teachers keep all career routes open while a laboratory grant is tied to digital placements.
svg.desc: Handwritten amendments in the paper register preserve every pupil's options. Teachers refuse to stamp permanent tracks, but a grant icon is visibly chained to the placement board.
svg.text: Page 39, panel 3 · Staff-room two-plane shot across paper registers and a grant dependency screen

text.tspan: Teachers reject permanent placement, but the school
risks funding if it stops using the guidance.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
